items.title: Emerald Weapons
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Emerald weapons are everywhere in the village! This fantastic survival spawn includes ten craftable tools/weapons.
Fend off zombies with your spear, smash skeletons with your hammer, or craft golems, all made of emerald! Go into the castle and explore it.

+ Custom golem
+ Custom weapons and armor
+ By Voxelblocks

items.title: Blingy Hypebeasts
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
Get blingy at the party tonight! Try different, edgy styles and let your soul shine! Be the sun out of so many stars and show off your well-practiced dance moves. Everyone is hyped up and is waiting for the winner of this night, and you indeed have a big chance to be the king or queen of this memorable event! 

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Monster Hunters
items.creator: Team Visionary
items.description:
The city is invaded by creepy monsters who are scaring the people around. Therefore everyone will leave this planet. Are you brave enough to hunt all of the mobs down? If so, the squad is waiting for you to join them! You don't have to be a hunter; you can choose your favorite side and play by the rules. The hunt has begun!

+ 1 free skin
+ 16 skins
+ By Team Visionary

items.title: Mob Souls
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Spooky things are happening in Minecraft! It seems the players have set free the mobs' souls into the game to haunt everyone during Halloween! Become a mob by equipping one of these skins and scaring your friends!

- Ten hovering mob ghost skins
- One skin free

items.title: Trendy Style
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Awesome freestyle skins!

- 12 skins
- 1 free skin

items.title: Animal Print Teens
items.creator: FTB
items.description:
Show the animal inside you! Dress yourself up with these prints to impress your friends.

+ 8 animal skins!
+ FREE skin: Alex
+ Trendy, fashion & cute

By FTB

items.title: Elemental Conflux
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Let your imagination flow like water, shine like light, ignite like fire, and flood like a storm. With this Elemental Conflux skin pack, your role-playing will be much more intense and mystifying! The power of the Elements shall bloom in your name on Earth (and the Nether)!

- 20 varied elemental skins!
- By Varuna and Pathway Studios

items.title: Color Harmony HD
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Take your color game to the next level by sporting some of the trendiest clothes in this vibrant skin pack showcasing fits in all the colors of the rainbow. From sweaters to shirts, jeans and shorts, you can't go wrong!


- Includes 16 HD skins!
- Many options to choose from for any occasion
- By PixelPoly Digital & Pathway Studios

items.title: Dark Forest
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Humans have summoned Dark Forest spirits. A werewolf now lives in exile, looking for his fellow tribesmen. Come play amongst the trees with your friends as these Dark Spirits add wonder and challenge to your woodland adventures.

- 3 themed groves in the forest; one sprout from each grove.
- By Varuna & Pathway Studios

items.title: Streamers
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
You just can't get away from streaming and even want to be online for your fans? Then choose your optimal style for gaming and feel free to be who you are. And be ready for your next stream!

+ 10 different skins
+ 1 free skin

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Extreme Skyblock Parkour
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Will you make every jump in this extreme skyblock parkour?

- Recommended for keyboard and mouse
- 10 Epic Modules
- By Eternal Creations

items.title: Taj Mahal
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Explore the original Taj Mahal and live in it! This historically accurate monument makes for the perfect survival base, it includes:

- Giant storage areas
- Multiple furnished floors
- Enchanting and armory area
- Crop and tree farms
- Pre-built nether portal 
- Potion brewing room
- Smelting area and much more!

By Honeyfrost

items.title: Luxury Hotel
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Welcome to Luxury Hotel, a place where you can role-play with your friends as a billionaire! Stay in the luxury rooftop pools or in a room with a dream view, enjoy the sandy beach or the beautiful mountains.

- Great for role-play
- Stunning survival spawn
- By RareLoot

items.title: Spooky Blocks HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Spooky, scary, and colorful blocks! Be a monster, a cool pattern, or Halloween scenery. Great for having fun with friends during the holiday season or roleplay.

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: SKYBLOCK FUN!
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
This classic mini-game is perfect for you!
A great skyblock environment for anyone looking for a little sky survival excitement!

+ Includes 1 world

items.title: TNT+
items.creator: Pickaxe Studios
items.description:
+ Custom TNT items
+ Giant starting base
+ Includes a skin

Use new TNT and blast your way through survival!

items.title: Ultimate Trolling
items.creator: Enchanted
items.description:
Learn the best redstone traps with Ultimate Trolling! Tour around the booby-trapped castle to see what you stumble into. Watch out for lava, falling anvils, and even TNT. There may be danger around every corner! Are you ready to fool your friends?
- Learn to build 10 unique redstone traps
- 1 free skin
- By Enchanted

items.title: Teen Halloween Party
items.creator: Tomhmagic Creations
items.description:
Ready to have the best modern Halloween costume in the city? Look no further! With costumes like a ninja, vampire, dragon, zombie, witch, and even a wizard, you’ll have the most trendy roleplay outfits around.

- 14 skins 
- Includes 1 free ghost skin

items.title: Color Theory: Vibrating Colors
items.creator: Lebleb
items.description:
Wear the illusion of motion when to saturated colors are next to each other in this colorful funky pack!

There are 12 skins in this pack.

items.title: Calico Cats
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Cats? Check. Cute? Check. Lucky? Check! What more do you need! These cute and soft kitties are so adorable! Why are you still reading this! Enjoy calico cat heaven!

items.title: Scary Nether
items.creator: Blu Shutter Bug
items.description: Spooky scary nether creatures come out and play. They emerge in the dead of night to haunt your dreams. These creatures send goosebumps down your way. Are you prepared for a night full of fright? I hope so....

items.title: Wanderers HD
items.creator: Eneija
items.description:
Not all who wander are lost... and these colorful HD explorers are sure to be on quite the adventure!

» 5 unique designs
» 10 color variations
» Created by Eneija

items.title: Furry Friends
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Live the life of luxury as an adorable animal! Be a trendy fox, a cute hedgehog, or an adorable tiger, the choice is yours! It's time to embrace your inner animal!

- 16 Animal Skins!
- A variety of animals included!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Fall Fashion
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
Are you ready for fall? These teens are! It's time to put on plaid and scarves and enjoy the chilly weather and falling leaves!

- 8 Trendy Fall Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios
